content.short: dHEDGE provides socialized asset management on Ethereum, Optimism, and Polygon.
content.description: dHEDGE is a decentralized suite of open-source smart contracts deployed on Ethereum-based networks, including Ethereum, Polygon and Optimism. It functions as an asset management protocol that connects investors with investment managers in a censorship-resistant, non-custodial way. By leveraging blockchain technology, dHEDGE creates a permissionless platform that lets investors retain full ownership of their assets while enabling the best managers to trade invested capital on their behalf.

resources.title: Where dHEDGE's Revenue Actually Came From
resources.tldr: Roughly $2M in protocol income across 2025 without user incentives — about half from fees led by Toros Finance, the rest from market making and farming.
